heads.t: 駭客兜售4.6萬筆台積電員工個資！放話沒賣出就公開 公司回應了 昨日晚間在台積電的社群平台上，就有網友指出疑似有員工資料被駭客放上網兜售！該名駭客在地下論壇公然點名「台積電（TSMC）」，聲稱手握高達6.9GB、共計4.6萬筆員工詳細個資，並以3枚比特幣（約折合新台幣740萬元）的價格進行拍賣。賣家甚至狂妄放話，若一週內無人問津，將直接對外公開所有資料。針對此事件，台積電今（12）日回應，強調目前並無證據顯示公司內部系統遭到入侵，外洩資料與某雲端服務供應商系統相符，與生產及客戶機密無關。 3 分鐘前｜財經 駭客兜售4.6萬筆台積電員工個資！放話沒賣出就公開 公司回應了 3 分鐘前｜財經
heads.en: The hackers are selling 46,000 employees! The company responded last night. On the community platform where electricity is available, netizens have pointed to suspected employees being sold online by hackers. The hacker publicly named "TSMC" in the underground forum, claiming that he was holding 6.9 GB, a total of 46,000 employees, and auctioning at a price of three bitcoins (approximately $7.4 million). The sellers even talk in vain, and if no one cares for them in a week, they will make all the data available directly to the outside world. In response to the incident, Radio Day (12) responded, emphasizing that there was no evidence that the company’s internal system had been breached, that leaking data was consistent with a cloud service provider system and had nothing to do with production and client confidentiality. Three minutes ago, he sold 46,000 shares of electric staff. The company responded three minutes ago.

heads.t: 不能再用AI搶機票！美聯航開第一槍封殺 機器人代訂3風險曝 隨著人工智慧（AI）技術快速發展，越來越多人開始使用AI助理搜尋便宜機票、規劃旅遊行程，甚至直接代替自己完成訂票。不過，美國聯合航空（United Airlines）11日宣布，將禁止未經授權的第三方AI代理程式（AI agents）透過旗下訂票系統替旅客購買機票，理由包括個人資料外洩、誤購機票，以及可能違反航空安全法規。值得注意的是，AI仍可協助旅客查詢聯航航班與票價，但無法直接在聯航網站完成交易。 6 分鐘前｜國際 不能再用AI搶機票！美聯航開第一槍封殺 機器人代訂3風險曝 6 分鐘前｜國際
heads.en: The U.S.A.'s first shot to kill a robot, three risks, and with the rapid development of AI technology, more and more people are using AI's assistant to search for cheap tickets, plan tours, and even make their own reservations. However, U.S. United Airlines announced on 11 November that it would prohibit unauthorized third-party AI agents from buying tickets for passengers through the flag-based booking system, for reasons including personal data leaks, mispurchase tickets, and possible violations of aviation security laws. It is worth noting that AI can still assist passengers in checking United flights and fares, but it is not possible to complete transactions directly on the United Nations website. Six minutes ago, I couldn't get an AI ticket! U.S.A.'s first shot was fired.

heads.t: 櫻島火山再爆1200公尺煙柱竄天際！日氣象廳：恐持續噴發 日本鹿兒島縣櫻島火山於當地時間12日上午10時38分發生噴發，南岳山頂火口噴出的煙柱高達1200公尺，並朝西北方飄散。日本氣象廳持續維持第3級「入山管制」警戒，呼籲民眾在火口周圍約2公里範圍內，嚴防大型噴石與火山碎屑流的威脅。 9 分鐘前｜國際 櫻島火山再爆1200公尺煙柱竄天際！日氣象廳：恐持續噴發 9 分鐘前｜國際

heads.en: The ghost shaved her hair for more than 10 years! A 20-year-old girl recovered her hair from a new drug, and a 20-year-old girl in the north was affected by "ghost shaven" for more than 10 years, with almost all of her hair polished, leaving and entering with only a wig on, and her self-confidence was shattered. Recently, when the courage to seek help from the dermatologist was raised, the doctor learned that there had been no improvement in the treatment she had tried in the past, and that, as a result, the woman's hair grew only after she had taken oral micro-molecular medication. 21 minutes ago, the ghost shaved her hair for over 10 years!
